buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 50 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 50% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the

additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Generic Buyer Organization specific Integrity Pact shall have to be complied by all bidders. Bidders shall have to upload scanned copy of signed integrity pact as per Buyer organizations policy along with bid. Click here to view the file 3. Inspection Nominated Inspection Agency: On behalf of the Buyer organization, any one of the following Inspection Agency would be conducting inspection of stores before acceptance: Pre-dispatch Inspection at Seller Premises (applicable only if pre-dispatch inspection clause has been selected in ATC): Board of Officers as nominated by BRO Post Receipt Inspection at consignee site before acceptance of stores: Board of Officers as nominated by BRO 4. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Supply Installation Testing and Commissioning of Goods 5. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 6. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses ADDITIONAL TERMS & CONDITIONS Following additional Terms & Conditions on the subject Bid for procurement of Stone Crusher 40 T PH is mentioned: PQ CRITERIA/OTHER TERMS & CONDITIONS. 1. (a) Performance Evaluation of Offered equipment. If the offered equipment is not trial evaluated in BRO. The bidder must be an OEM and must have sold in market a minimum 2 Nos of plant of similar or higher capacity in last three years, ending o n 31st March of the previous financial year . Copies of related Supply Orders and Performance certi ficates, in support of these will be submitted by the bidder. BRO reserves the right to conduct limit ed ‘No Cost No Commitment’ basis performance trials for a period of 50 hours operation at a mutu ally agreed project location including Vendor Premises. OR If the offered equipment is trial evaluated in BRO and is not in service in

BRO / Indian Army. The offered equipment has been trial evaluated and found successful in BRO/ h as been found qualified in staff evaluation for procurement by Indian Army. Documentary proof in support of this be enclosed. OR If the offered equipment is in service in BRO. The offered equipment is presently in service with BR O and its Performance is Satisfactory. Performance of equipment already inducted in BRO shall be evaluated internally by E4 (Repair)/TA Dte/HQ DGBR. In case found unsatisfactory, the bid of conce rned bidder shall be rejected. In this regard the decision of BRO is final. (b) Experience Criteria : The Bidder i.e. OEM (themselves or through resellers(s)) should hav e regularly, manufactured and supplied same or similar Category Products for 3 years before the b id opening date. Copies of relevant contracts to be submitted along with bid in support of having s upplied a definite quantity during each of the year. 2. Commissioning of equipment (By Seller). The equipment shall be commissioned by the Seller within a maximum period of 30 days from the date of receipt of communication from the consignee confirming that the equipment is ready for co mmissioning. For any delay in commissioning of such equipment beyond 30 days of receipt of com munication, a penalty @ 0.10% of the contract price per day per equipment, subject to a maximum of 10% of the value of non-commissioned equipments, shall be levied on the S eller. This amount shall be recovered either from any payment due to the SELLER or fro m the Performance Bank Guarantee, whichever is applicable. 3. Warranty (i) The SELLER warrants that the goods supplied under this contract conform to technical speci fications prescribed and shall perform according to the said Technical Specifications. (ii) The SELLER warrants for a period of 12 months or 1000 operational hours from the date of c ommissioning, whichever is earlier, that the goods/stores supplied under this contract and each co mponent used in the manufacture thereof shall be free from all types of defects/failures. (iii) Idling charges will be applicable for the period of defects. 4. Resources for providing spares & consumables for maintenance up to 10 years: The bidde r should have adequate facilities pan India to carry out after sales service at various consignees for a total period of 10 (Ten) years including Guarantee/Warranty period of 01(One) year and 09 (Nine) years thereaft er in terms of supply of spares. 5. Idling Charges. In case of defects developing during the warranty period, if the equipment is not put back in running condition (by Seller) within a period of maximum of 21 days from the date of issue of notification, failing which the seller shall be liable to be charged an idling cost for the entire delay duration (Incl 21 days) @ INR Rs. 14403.00 (Rupees Fourteen Thousand Four Hun dred Three Only) per day subject to a maximum of 5% of the contract value, shall be levied on the Seller. If there is further such delay after reaching this limit, the Procuring Entity shall be entitled to enca shment of the whole of Performance Bank Guarantee, besides recording the adverse performance of the co ntractor for future tenders. 6. Price to be quoted shall inclusive of GST & freight charges.

7. This bid is reserved for OEMs only. 8. Training: Successful bidder shall provide training at consignee location for operators and field work shop personnels. The training will be conducted for a minimum of Twenty One Days. The training will be conducted in two Phases. Phase one training of Seven Days duration within 90 days post-delivery and Phase two training of Fourteen Days duration 90 days prior to termination of warranty. 9. Engineering Support Package. (i) Tools. One set of tools required for undertaking regular and periodical maintenance, shall b e provided along with the each equipment, on FREE OF COST. (ii) MRLS. Three Set of hard copy of document containing Manufacturer Recommended List of S pares (MRLS) covering both repair & maintenance spares for 1000Hrs/2000 Hrs/5000 Hrs and list o f one set document containing list of overhaul spares for 100 equipment shall be provided at the ti me of PDI. (iii) Technical Literature: All Technical Literatures (hard copy in English) described below shall b e supplied by the Seller on FREE OF COST along with each equipments:- (aa) Operation, Repair and maintenance manual for both engine and equipment. (ab) Workshop manual for both engine and equipment. (ac) Illustrated parts catalogue for both engine and equipment. (ad) Illustrated list of Special Maintenance Tools, if any. (ae) Lubrication charts for complete equipment. (af) In addition, following literature to be handed over to HQ DGBR/ E4 Tech :- (i)Illustrated parts catalogue of engine and equipment – 05Sets. (ii)Running, Repair and Maint manual for both engine and equipment – 03Sets. (iii)Lubrication charts for complete equipment – 03Sets. (iv)Workshop manual for both engine and equipment – 02Sets. (v)Soft copy of all above literature at S/No. (i) to (iv) – 01Set. 10. The bidder shall submit a certificate on compliance of Rule 144 (xi)of GFR 2017 as per Ministry of Fin ance, Department of Expenditure , Public Procurement Division vide their order Nos dated 23 Jul 2020 and its subsequent Procurement Orders 2 and 3dated 23 and24 Jul 2020vide their File No 06 / 18 / 2019. Model Certificate enclosed as Appendix ‘A’. Appendix ‘A’
